name: OpenAlex
description: An open catalogue of the scholarly record: ~270 million works with authors, institutions, venues, topics, open-access status and full citation graph. Successor to Microsoft Academic Graph, CC0, no key, and the only free source that will hand you per-year citation counts for an arbitrary set of papers.

access.auth_note: no key; send mailto= or a User-Agent with an address to reach the polite pool, which is faster and rarely throttled
access.size_hint: full snapshot ~330 GB; a filtered cursor walk of 135,000 works takes about 3 minutes
access.pagination: cursor=* then the returned next_cursor; per-page max 200. The offset-based page= stops working past 10,000 results.

probes.description: The paging idiom that actually scales

recipes.title: Walk a filtered set with a cursor

gotchas.trap: In counts_by_year the count key is called cited_by_count, not count. Reading c['count'] gives a KeyError halfway through a long run.
counts_by_year only runs from 2012 to the present, whatever the publication year.
gotchas.fix: For citation history before 2012 you need a different source; do not read the truncation as zero citations.

gotchas.trap: is_retracted comes from publisher metadata and over-flags badly - it marks about twice as many works as Retraction Watch has notices for.
gotchas.fix: Join to the Retraction Watch database on normalised DOI rather than trusting either alone.

gotchas.trap: Without select= you pull the entire work object, which is 10-50x the bytes you need.
gotchas.fix: Always pass select= with just the fields you use.
